# Every 15- and 16-digit identifier that may appear in this repository.
#
# CI fails on any other one, because a 15-digit literal is most likely a real
# IMSI and a real IMSI is subscriber-identifying data.
#
# Rules for adding an entry:
#   * IMSIs should use MCC 001 / MNC 01, the reserved test network.
#   * Where a real MCC is unavoidable — the MNC-length tests need one, since
#     whether an MNC is 2 or 3 digits depends on the country — the MSIN must be
#     obviously synthetic (zero-filled).
#   * IMEIs come from documented example ranges and are not tied to a device.
#
# Format: one identifier per line. Comments and blank lines are ignored.

# --- IMSIs, reserved test network (MCC 001, MNC 01) --------------------------
001010000000001
001010000000002
001010000000003
001010000000004
001010000000009
001010000000010
001010000000011
001019999999999
001010000000000

# --- IMSIs with a real MCC, used only to test MNC length ---------------------
# 450 = Republic of Korea (2-digit MNC)
450050000000001
# 310 = United States, 302 = Canada (3-digit MNC)
310260000000001
302720000000001

# --- IMEIs --------------------------------------------------------------------
356938035643809
356938035643800
3569380356438091
# All-zeros: used to prove a non-Luhn IMEI is still accepted, and as the id of
# the console's XSS-payload test device.
000000000000000
000000000000001
35693803564380
